title: Pixel 9 Pro XL camera retrieval replay
question: How is the camera in low light?

stages.label: Query embedding
stages.detail: The user question is embedded and kept phone-scoped.

stages.label: Vector candidates
stages.detail: Nearest review chunks are pulled from the phone corpus.

stages.label: Keyword candidates
stages.detail: Camera, night, low-light, zoom, and video terms widen recall.

stages.label: RRF fusion
stages.detail: Overlapping vector and keyword results are blended by rank.

stages.label: MMR diversify
stages.detail: Near-duplicate chunks are reduced so sources do not crowd each other out.

stages.label: Cited context
stages.detail: The answer uses the highest-scoring, source-diverse evidence.

finalChunks.excerpt: Night shots keep strong exposure and color, while moving subjects still need steadier hands.
The main sensor favors detail preservation over aggressive brightening in dim scenes.
Users praise night mode consistency, with complaints mostly around motion blur indoors.
